firmographics.name: Acme Cloud
firmographics.description: Managed cloud platform that lets engineering teams ship and scale services without operating Kubernetes themselves.

documents.title: About Acme Cloud
documents.snippet: Acme Cloud is a remote-first company of 620 employees whose managed platform is used by more than 4,000 engineering teams.
documents.body: Acme Cloud is a remote-first company of 620 employees. Our managed cloud platform is used by more than 4,000 engineering teams to ship and scale services without operating Kubernetes directly. We are headquartered in San Francisco with employees across North America and Europe.

documents.title: Acme Cloud raises $55M Series B to expand go-to-market
documents.snippet: Acme Cloud raised a $55M Series B led by Lightspeed in March 2026, earmarking the round to expand its go-to-market and data teams.
documents.body: Acme Cloud announced a $55M Series B led by Lightspeed Venture Partners in March 2026. CEO statements indicate the capital will fund expansion of the company's go-to-market organization and a new central data team tasked with unifying product and revenue analytics.

documents.title: Careers — Acme Cloud
documents.snippet: Acme Cloud is hiring a Head of Revenue Operations plus three RevOps analysts to unify its go-to-market data stack.
documents.body: Open roles at Acme Cloud include Head of Revenue Operations, three Revenue Operations Analysts, and two data engineers. The Head of RevOps job description calls out 'unifying our fragmented go-to-market data stack' and 'building a single source of truth for pipeline and usage' as priorities.

documents.title: Introducing usage-based billing
documents.snippet: Acme Cloud launched usage-based billing in February 2026, citing strong customer demand for consumption pricing.
documents.body: In February 2026 Acme Cloud rolled out usage-based billing. The post notes that consumption pricing makes product-usage data central to how the company forecasts revenue and identifies expansion opportunities.

documents.title: How we centralized analytics on Snowflake
documents.snippet: Acme Cloud migrated its analytics to Snowflake in late 2025 to centralize product and revenue data in one warehouse.
documents.body: Acme Cloud's data team describes migrating analytics to Snowflake in late 2025. A stated goal was to bring product-usage events and CRM data into one warehouse so go-to-market teams could act on the same numbers.
